product.name: Upstash Redis
product.description: A serverless, low-latency key-value store based on Redis, offering automatic scaling, global replication, and persistent storage with a REST API interface.

product.name: Upstash Vector
product.description: A serverless vector database for storing and querying vector embeddings, enabling semantic search and AI-driven applications.

product.name: Upstash QStash
product.description: A serverless message queue and task scheduler that enables reliable, scheduled, and asynchronous API requests with retry mechanisms.

product.name: Upstash Workflow
product.description: A serverless workflow orchestration platform that automates complex, multi-step processes by chaining API calls and managing task execution.

product.name: Upstash Search
product.description: A serverless search service that provides indexing and querying capabilities for structured and unstructured data via REST APIs.
